missions.title: Enter the War Room
missions.description: Join the official Telegram portal, introduce your handle, and declare your presence for the 7-day marathon.

missions.title: Broadcast the Takeover
missions.description: Publish a post to X explaining why community takeovers outlast developer-owned tokens. Ready template below in the Armory.

missions.title: Verify Official Channels
missions.description: Confirm you follow @HuhCatOnSol_ on X and bookmark the Mission Control dashboard for daily check-ins.

missions.title: Deploy Bender to the Timeline
missions.description: Post a high-energy Huh Cat meme to X tagging @HuhCatOnSol_ and using the $HUHCAT cashtag. Remind Solana that Bender has 3.4M organic fans.

missions.title: Raid a Trending Cat Post
missions.description: Find a trending Solana meme thread and drop the iconic Huh Cat reaction video or GIF with a sharp one-liner.

missions.title: Share Meme Fuel in TG
missions.description: Upload a fresh Huh Cat image, sticker, or reaction template directly into the Telegram group chat.

missions.title: Enlist One Real Holder
missions.description: Personally message one disciplined crypto trader you respect and introduce them to the HUHCAT community takeover thesis.

missions.title: Target an Alpha Call Account
missions.description: Reply under an influential Solana trader asking for project suggestions with our community-led thesis. No spam, pure conviction.

missions.title: Engage Community Raids
missions.description: Interact with and repost at least three fellow $HUHCAT community members' posts from the past 24 hours.

missions.title: Set a High Score
missions.description: Launch the official HUHCAT browser game, survive multiple pipe obstacles, and take a screenshot of your top score.

missions.title: Post Your Score Challenge
missions.description: Tweet your game screenshot and challenge the Solana timeline to beat your personal best. Link the game.

missions.title: Post Score in Telegram
missions.description: Drop your gaming screenshot into the Telegram room to claim bragging rights on today's leaderboard.

missions.title: Author a Thesis Post
missions.description: Publish a thoughtful post on X breaking down why 99 percent of tokens die after three days and how HUHCAT solves continuity.

missions.title: Quote-Tweet the Masterplan
missions.description: Quote-tweet the official @HuhCatOnSol_ marathon announcement with your personal thoughts on holding culture.

missions.title: Rally the Chat
missions.description: Drop a high-conviction message in the Telegram community room reinforcing why decentralized holders do not fold under red candles.

missions.title: Audit the Timeline
missions.description: Scan recent mentions of $HUHCAT on X. Like, bookmark, and leave substantive comments on at least five holder posts.

missions.title: Publish a Conviction Thread
missions.description: Draft a multi-part post or detailed statement detailing your personal conviction in holder-built infrastructure.

missions.title: Voice Room Attendance
missions.description: Join the community Telegram voice chat or X Space to discuss sprint coordination and next steps.

missions.title: Mint Your Rank Card
missions.description: Generate your final Season 1 Rank Card below. Download the 960x960 graphic directly to your device.

missions.title: Broadcast Your Rank
missions.description: Post your completed Rank Card to X with your 7-day sprint recap, tagging @HuhCatOnSol_ to lock in your permanent record.

missions.title: Share Final Proof in TG
missions.description: Post your Rank Card and marathon proof in the Telegram room to receive your community honors before Season 2.
